[[Duck Hunt Event|Duck Hunt]] |first_wave_appearance = 5 ([[Duck Hunt Event|Duck Hunt]]) |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]12Beyond wave 14, '''Fat Ducky''' scaled its health with time. |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Average (3) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None |spawned_by = [[Eggroll]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Fat Ducky''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[D00M's Revenge]] as part of the [[Duck Hunt Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned again in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It had higher health than enemies that appeared before it, but an average speed. Beyond wave 14, its health would increase over time. The '''Fat Ducky''' could be spawned by the [[Eggroll]]. ==Appearance== The '''Fat Ducky''' is an oversized yellow duck with black eyes and an orange beak. Its body is significantly larger than most other ducky enemies, and has a slightly smaller head. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[D00M's Revenge]] is listed instead. *Cheap towers like the [[Soldier]] and [[Golden Scout]] fare well against the '''Fat Ducky'''. **Multiple Level 2 [[Sniper]]s are recommended for their long range. In addition, the [[Sniper]] can also counter the [[Flying Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Flying Ducky]] that debuts later on in the game. *As many of these spawn, towers that can damage multiple enemies at once, like the [[Executioner]], can clear out hordes of this enemy. **Like the [[Sniper]], the [[Executioner]] can counter the [[Flying Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Flying Ducky]]. Do be aware that its hidden detection is too expensive to deal with [[Spy Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Spy Duckies]], a hidden enemy that debuts later on in the game. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseDRFatDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Spring Trailer|'''Fat Ducky''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LegacyFatDuckyIconIG.png|'''Fat Ducky''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *This enemy can be seen in the {{Color|DuckHunt|Ducky}} skin for the [[Farm]]. ==Update History== *'''17 April 2022''' - [[v1.2.0]] **'''Fat Ducky''' added. *'''28 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.4]] **'''Fat Ducky''' removed. *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''Fat Ducky''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Fat Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Fat Ducky]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from the [[Ducky Revenge Event]]. ==Notes== {{D00MRevenge|[[Cool Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Cool Ducky]]|Wave 3|Fat Ducky|Wave 5|[[Spy Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Spy Ducky]]|Wave 7}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Fat Ducky}}
